item.title: Ensenada Surf Spots Saved as President Cancels Destructive Port Expansion
item.description: Local activists are celebrating after the Mexican government abandoned port expansion plans that would have destroyed several local surf spots.

item.title: New Lineup Rules in Bali: Beginners Banned From Certain Areas, Instructors Required
item.description: The surfers of Medewi, Bali are taking lineup overcrowding into their own hands, publishing a new set of rules that surfers must follow.

item.title: Former WSL Chief Erik Logan Named CEO at Tony Robbins Conglomerate
item.description: ELO has found his new gig. According to a new announcement, former WSL head Erik Logan will be the new CEO of Robbins Research International.

item.title: The Seabed Curtain Project Wants to Build a Giant Wall Around the ‘Doomsday Glacier’
item.description: Thwaites Glacier, better known as the "Doomsday Glacier," is in rough shape. The Seabed Curtain Project has a fix that's straight out of science fiction.

item.title: Olympic Biathlete Confesses to Cheating on His Girlfriend on Live Television
item.description: Sturla Holm Lægreid won an Olympic bronze medal on Tuesday, but during his interview afterwards, he he confessed to cheating on his girlfriend.

item.title: Skier Jim Morrison Discusses the First Descent of the Trango Towers’ West Face
item.description: For nearly 50 years, the Great Trango Towers have stood as a proving ground for the limits of human perseverance. Jim Morrison and his team met that challenge.

item.title: Australian Snowboarder Cam Bolton Breaks Neck During Olympic Training
item.description: Australian snowboarder Cam Bolton has broken his neck in training. The incident is the latest in a rash of injuries to befall Winter Games athletes.

item.title: California Activists Warn of Environmental Damage from Illegal Cannabis Farms
item.description: Environmentalists and politicians have sounded the alarm regarding the challenges in mitigating environmental damage caused by illegal marijuana farms.

item.title: 4 Western U.S. States Now Have Worst February Snowpack In 45 Years
item.description: The latest winter conditions snapshot comes from a report published by the National Integrated Drought Information System on February 5, 2026.

item.title: Satellite Image Shows Japan’s Hokkaido Island Blanketed in Snow
item.description: The island of Hokkaido, Japan typically sees more than 140 days of snowfall each year and more than six meters of snow accumulation (20 feet).
